label: CONDITIONAL RESAMPLING STABILITY
generator: numpy.PCG64; reset same seed per block length
missing_days: retain their empty slots; never redraw
repeated_days: repeat sums and counts with multiplicity
eligibility: channel-specific finite nonnegative flux after integrity-v2 extraction; valid zero retained; recompute coverage and percentile in every replicate
signed_difference: channel_b minus channel_a in degrees; direct longitude difference valid within fixed region -100..20
interpretation: descriptive conditional resampling quantiles, not calibrated physical-position confidence or joint regions; nonnegative distances cannot establish significance

morphology.common_support: intersection of all three channel coverage masks and finite flux

limitations: 31 days cannot establish stationarity or reliable long-run dependence
only 25 possible seven-day starts and five draws including trimmed fifth block
edge dates have lower selection probability than middle dates for length >1; no month-end wrap
block joins break dependence; 1-day draws remove cross-day dependence
thresholded centroid is nonlinear and coverage-dependent; inference not calibrated
channel observations are fitted outputs from shared instrument processing, not independent measurements
